decisions.reason: The black-finish range builds on the firm's existing drainage and metal finishing capabilities, so the firm can likely assimilate and improve it.
The shower channel leverages existing metal fabrication knowledge and has dedicated website presence, indicating investment and potential.
The pump-assisted solution requires electro-mechanical knowledge outside the firm's core metal fabrication, limiting its ability to interpret results and improve the product.
Tileable floor drains with grating are core metal fabrication products closely aligned with existing knowledge.
Stainless steel design grates fit within the firm's established stainless fabrication and design capabilities.
